replies.author: Cubey42
replies.body:
Yeah I would totally surmise your age from your post. Your idea just isn't very deep its just normal human interaction with managing costs. how you gonna make the money in this game? working a job? people just give you money? I gotta build friendships with AI-powered NPCs so I can what? what do I get out of it? meeting someone of a different culture? you say its a unique concept, but its fundamentally just as you describe, traveling and seeing the world. 

  
And yes if you really wanted to, you don't really need money besides crossing some borders or getting to the other side of the pond.

replies.author: SubstantialHumor8
replies.body: You could either get money from helping people in game with tasks , maybe doing side quests and I’d say it’s a unique concept of a game not a unique life concept? and it could help people who are physically or financially unable to travel the world feel more connected with different cultures and see the world. Like I said I can’t code games just thought it was a fun lil idea. It could also feature language learning in a more connecting and in real world situations.
